newsitem.title: CANADA: AMOCO, ATCO IN CANADA POWER PROJECT.
newsitem.headline: AMOCO, ATCO IN CANADA POWER PROJECT.

text.p: Units of Amoco Corp and ATCO Ltd said on Thursday they planned to build a C$75 million cogeneration plant at Amoco's Primrose heavy oil operation in northeastern Alberta.
Amoco Canada Petroleum Co Ltd and ATCO subsidiary CU Power International Ltd said the plant would use natural gas as a fuel source to generate electricity.

Through the recovery of exhaust heat, it would generate steam to be used by Amoco to recover heavy oil at its Primrose and Wolf Lake, Alberta fields. Surplus electricity would be sold to the Power Pool of Alberta.
